# tersa

Compact spec in, polished shadcn code out. Write a `.tsa` file, run `tersa gen app.tsa -o out/`,
get a Next.js (App Router) + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui app with mock data, loading and empty states,
responsive layout and design tokens. Deterministic: same spec, same code.

## Grammar (v0)

- One node per line. Indent 2 spaces to nest. `# ` starts a comment.
- Line shape: `type positional... key=value flag "Text" @data #id ~variant -> action`
- `"Text"` label or title. `@name` binds data (dots only on kpi: `@user.revenue`).
- `#id` sets an element id. `~variant` picks a style variant.
- `-> api.fn`, `-> api.fn(col)` calls a stub in lib/api.ts; `-> /path` navigates.
- First line must be `app`. `page` lines sit at the top level after it. Everything else nests under a page.

## Nodes

```
app "Name" [theme=aurora|ember] [dark] [nav=sidebar|top|none]
page /path "Title"
row [kpi*N @list]                     # N kpi cards from a list of {label,value,delta}
grid 1..6                             # responsive columns
card ["Title"]
hero "Headline" [subtitle=...] [align=center|left]   # child button/text for actions
features @list [cols=1..4] ["Title"]                 # list rows: title, description
cta "Heading" [subtitle=...]                         # child buttons
kpi @data.field ["Label"] [format=number|money|percent]
chart line|bar @list x=key [y=key] ["Title"]
table @list cols=key[:type],... [sort] [search] [page=N] ["Title"]
  action "Label" [~variant] -> api.fn(col,...) [confirm]
form [@record] fields=name[:type],... -> api.fn ["Title"] [submit="Label"]
button "Label" [~variant] [-> api.fn | -> /path]
text "Copy" [~heading|~muted]
```

Column types: text number money badge date email. Field types: text email number select(a|b) textarea checkbox.
Variants (button/action): default destructive outline secondary ghost.

## Example

```
app "Acme Ops" theme=aurora dark nav=sidebar
page /dashboard "Overview"
  row kpi*4 @metrics
  grid 2
    chart line @revenue x=month y=total "Revenue"
    chart bar @signups x=week "Signups"
  table @orders cols=id,customer,total:money,status:badge sort search page=20
    action "Refund" ~destructive -> api.refund(id) confirm
page /settings "Settings"
  form @user fields=name,email:email,plan:select(free|pro) -> api.saveUser
```

## Output

`app/<path>/page.tsx` + `loading.tsx` per page, `app/layout.tsx` (shell + nav), `app/error.tsx`,
`app/globals.css` (tokens), `lib/data.ts` (mock data), `lib/api.ts` (action stubs), `lib/stubs.ts`
(fetch placeholders), `components/ui/*` (shadcn-style), `components/tersa/*` (kpi, charts,
data-table, form, shell, hero, features, cta).

## Themes

`aurora` and `ember`: W3C DTCG tokens in OKLCH, built with Style Dictionary into `:root` / `.dark`
CSS variables and a Tailwind `@theme inline` block. Use token utilities (`bg-primary`,
`text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `fill-chart-1`); never raw hex or px.

## CLI

`tersa init` scaffolds a project. `tersa check` validates. `tersa diff` previews regen. `tersa gen`
writes `out/`. Spec errors exit `2`.

## Rules for agents

1. Read `app.tsa` first; change the spec, not the generated layout.
2. Run `tersa check` then `tersa diff` before `tersa gen`. Errors show `file:line:col`, caret, hint.
3. Custom logic in `@tersa-slot begin custom` regions in `lib/api.ts` / `lib/data.ts`. Keep tokens.
